name: Navigation
description: Multi-page surface navigation, base path configuration, and route handling

knowledge.purpose: Resolve, link, and navigate between surfaces inside an app — handles base paths, route params, and history
useCases: Internal link from one surface to another (button.href, link.href)
Stepper or wizard that survives a refresh by syncing step to the URL
antiPatterns: Hard-coded full URLs that break when the app moves to another base path
Client-only state for things that should be deep-linkable (filter, page number)
Calling window.location.* directly instead of going through the capability

fields.label: Base Path
fields.description: Base path prefix for all routes
